blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday said there were congressmen who wanted to remove in the 2027 budget a provision against political intervention in the distribution of government assistance. He said removing the anti-epal limitations could lead to the politicization of the Department of Social Welfare and Development’s (DSWD) Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program. During the Senate deliberations on the proposed 2027 DSWD budget, Lacson questioned whether the department indeed had full control over the distribution of AICS aid. Sen.
